environment.buildMode: Vite SSR bundle, unminified, Node runtime

method.fixture: Deterministic generated SRT with simplified/traditional Chinese, emoji, HTML tags, spaces and multiline bodies; every 23rd cue is whitespace-only.
method.workflowThree: Same operation semantics, one decode/parse and one final serialize/encode.
method.complexCases: UTF-16LE, strict GB18030 and source-preserving Chinese ASS; source-Chinese stage breakdown is NOT_MEASURED (total measured).
method.timing: Each tool decodes, parses, transforms, serializes (including existing final-output parse verification), and encodes. Stage-boundary memory sampling is included; output hashing is excluded.
method.inputReads: Engine cases use in-memory bytes. ioMeasurements separately samples warm-cache Node filesystem reads and temp-write+fsync+rename inside the controlled benchmark directory; this is not a measurement of Rust IPC, filesystem permission dialogs or cold storage.
method.workerLifecycle: Node pure-engine sequential baseline; actual browser Worker startup/cancellation NOT_MEASURED in this report.
method.memory: Stage-boundary heap/RSS samples, not a reliable true peak; GC runs before each sample when --expose-gc is used.
method.temporaryBundle: src-tauri/target/benchmark/run-<uuid>, generated IO fixtures and bundles deleted after completion
